```typescript
  const response = await client.addFedoraClient({
    client_name: "my-new-fedora-client",
    redirect_uri: "https://example.com/callback",

  console.log("Fedora client created:", response);
  return response;
}
```

```typescript
// Create a new Fedora client with all optional parameters specified.
async function createFedoraClientWithOptions() {
  const response = await client.addFedoraClient({
    client_name: "another-fedora-client",
    redirect_uri: "https://another.example.com/callback",
    description: "Client for testing purposes",
    scopes: ["openid", "profile", "email"],
    post_logout_redirect_uri: "https://another.example.com/logout",

}
```
